visualQualityCheckpoints.expected: Each screen opens with a clear page title + context row or hero metric that identifies the screen purpose.

styleContinuityAnchors.colorSystem: Indigo primary #4F46E5, cyan accent #0891B2, slate neutrals #F8FAFC to #0F172A
styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: Inter + Noto Sans SC, display/h1/h2/h3/body/small/caption scale
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: White cards on slate-50 background, border-led static surfaces, shadow only for floating layers
styleContinuityAnchors.shapeLanguage: Rounded rectangles, soft but precise, no sharp corners on cards and buttons

pages.title: 教师工作台
pages.visualNorthStar: A clean command center for teachers: top stats row, quick-action cards, and a recent-skills table with status badges.
pages.compositionPattern: Sidebar + header frame, three-row main: stats → quick actions → data table.

pages.title: 创建助手·教学信息采集
pages.visualNorthStar: A focused multi-step wizard with a top stepper and tabbed form sections for structured teaching information.
pages.compositionPattern: Stepper header + tab bar + single-column form groups + sticky bottom action bar.

pages.title: 知识库管理
pages.visualNorthStar: A file-management workspace with an upload dropzone, processing-status table, and a test-retrieval panel.
pages.compositionPattern: Two-column main: upload + file list left, vector DB info + test search right.

pages.title: 技能预览与调试
pages.visualNorthStar: A split-view chat tester: collapsible config panel on the left, conversation stream with cited sources on the right.
pages.compositionPattern: Three-column layout: config sidebar, chat stream, input anchored bottom; source citations under each assistant message.

pages.title: 学生学习台
pages.visualNorthStar: A welcoming student hub: progress summary, enrolled courses grid, and quick entry to AI tutoring chat.
pages.compositionPattern: Top header with student nav, main: progress cards → course grid → recent activity.
